title: Technovate 2026: 36-Hour National Hackathon
description: Build innovative solutions in AI, Climate Tech, and FinTech. 36 hours of non-stop coding, mentoring, free food, and exciting cash prizes up to ₹2,50,000.

title: Dhwani '26: Annual Inter-College Cultural Fest & Battle of Bands
description: The largest student cultural fest featuring electrifying battle of bands, classical fusion dances, street plays, food stalls, and a celebrity DJ night.

title: National Student AI & Robotics Summit 2026
description: Keynotes from Google DeepMind and IISc researchers, autonomous drone obstacle demos, humanoid robot showcases, and interactive LLM agent workshops.

title: Campus Valorant & BGMI Esports Championship Finals
description: Cheer for the top collegiate esports rosters clashing on stage with live casting, LED main screens, gaming gear giveaways, and cosplay contests.

title: 'Tughlaq' Classic Kannada Drama by Campus Guild
description: Girish Karnad's historic masterpiece staged by the award-winning student repertory company with live Carnatic percussion and traditional costume design.

title: VentureNest Student Startup Pitch & Angel Demo Day
description: Watch 15 shortlisted student founders pitch ventures to seed venture capitalists, angel investors, and tech leaders. Includes networking high tea.

title: Raag & Rhythm: Indo-Western Classical Fusion Night
description: A spellbinding evening of sitar, violin, drums, and saxophone featuring student prodigies performing original ragas adapted to modern jazz.

title: Hands-on Ethical Hacking & Cyber Defense Bootcamp
description: Intensive hands-on masterclass covering web application vulnerabilities, CTF challenges, network packet inspection, and bug bounty methodologies.

title: TEDx Youth: Innovating for Tomorrow's Bharat
description: Independent TED conference bringing 8 visionary voices spanning grassroots education, aerospace engineering, local arts, and ethical artificial intelligence.

title: RoboClash: Inter-University Combat Robotics League
description: Armored remote-controlled bots battle in an enclosed steel arena. Flame throwers, spinning saws, and high-impact flippers.
